title: Where does the lift reach from the Food Court?
description: The lift starts at the Food Court and the plus two button is pressed. The starting floor and the movement are put into the rule Starting Floor plus Movement equals Target Floor. Keeko thinks the lift reaches floor two because the button says plus two, and the real starting floor breaks that doubt.
teaching_notes: One idea: the target floor is the starting floor added to the movement. Watch for students who read the movement as the floor, as if the lift always started at zero.

source: Start from the Food Court and press +2 in the lift. Where wi
video_script.why: A child learns to add a movement to a starting floor, because every later integer sum is a start plus a movement.
video_script.substitution: the book's own lift starting at the Food Court and moving up two floors
video_script.anchor: the lift of {{NAME_10}} starting at the Food Court, floor +1, with the plus button pressed twice
video_script.wrong_move: reads the press as the target floor, counting from the ground floor instead of from the Food Court
video_script.payoff_line: The movement is counted from the starting floor.

final_answer.spoken: floor plus three, which is the Book Store

names.{{NAME_10}}: the multi-storey block of floors above and below the ground, used as the model for integers

never_show: the target floor before the answer
maths_rules: The Food Court is floor +1 and the press is +2, so (+1) + (+2) = +3.
Floor +3 is the Book Store, passing the Art Centre (+2) on the way.
video_script.design: One idea: the movement is added to the starting floor, not to zero. One lift picture throughout; the starting floor is outlined and the lift climbs from it. Keeko's doubt is broken by the lift climbing from the Food Court.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the lift reaches floor two, because the button says plus two.
<bookmark mark='from'/>But the lift does not start at the ground floor. It starts at the Food Court.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>We begin counting at the Food Court, and not at zero.
